name: Markov
long_description:
Markov is the data lab for engineering and computer-use AI. We capture real work from domain experts and craft high-fidelity datasets and RL environments.

We built the most complex tasks and RL environments sourced through manufacturing experts proficient in AutoCAD, SOLIDWORKS, CATIA, Revit, Siemens NX and more. Our computer-use datasets are action-labelled, narrated and sourced from domain experts in design and enterprise software.

We work with frontier AI labs and we've built over 10,000 CAD environments and collected over 500,000 hours of computer-use data. Our open-source datasets have 800,000+ downloads on Hugging Face.
one_liner: The data lab for engineering and computer-use AI.
